text: 科创50ETF华夏(588000)成交额达130亿元，创业板ETF易方达(159915)成交额达138亿元，均刷新2024年9月24日以来最高成交记录。2只ETF在924行情后最高记录分别为2025年8月28日的127.14亿元和2026年1月16日的137.21亿元。
text_en: The turnover of STAR 50 ETF ChinaAMC (588000) reached RMB 13 billion, and the turnover of ChiNext ETF E Fund (159915) reached RMB 13.8 billion, both setting new high records since September 24, 2024. The previous post-924 rally records for these two ETFs were RMB 12.714 billion on August 28, 2025, and RMB 13.721 billion on January 16, 2026, respectively.
